title: Clear failure markers immediately in Reports
summary: Reports failure-marker clear now projects successful clear results into the loaded WebView failure table immediately, before the broader authoritative refresh completes.
reason: The operator reported that clearing all errors left the old failure rows visible for a short delay. The backend clear request was already authoritative, but the WebView waited for refreshAll before updating the table.
behavior_before: After a successful /api/failures/clear call, Reports cleared selection state and then waited for refreshAll, so the old failure rows could remain visible until the backend refresh finished.
behavior_after: After a successful clear, Reports immediately removes cleared marker rows locally, switches all-marker clears to an empty marker-source view, updates counts/detail text, and still runs refreshAll for authoritative backend state.
tests_added: tests/webview/test_webview_browser_maintenance_reports_smoke.py: browser regression holding refreshAll pending during clear-all
rollback_plan: Revert the local clear projection in apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/reportsView.js plus the related static and browser smoke assertions.
notes: No backend clear route, filesystem policy, media policy, source/scratch/output handling, pending publish, queue mutation, settings persistence, or media files are changed. The WebView still posts only /api/failures/clear and refreshes backend state afterward.
